name: multi-functional-creator
description: Professional control panel for building panels, sites, apps, APIs and 3D scenes — with a secrets vault and an expert AI copilot.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @mfc/core build && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @mfc/server dev" "pnpm --filter @mfc/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @mfc/core build && pnpm --filter @mfc/server build && pnpm --filter @mfc/web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @mfc/core build && pnpm --filter @mfc/core test && pnpm --filter @mfc/server test
